description: Elections Commission - N. J. P. Silva of the Kolonnawa Urban Council has vacated his office of the member of the United National Party - M. Rajakumaran of the Kolonnawa Urban Council has vacated his office of the member of the United National Party
categorisation: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Kolonnawa Urban Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and local authority member status changes, which is specifically covered by Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral matters under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
